description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeLanguageAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee language proficiency data within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, listing, and deleting employee language records, along with validation rules and detailed documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPI
classes.description: Defines REST endpoints for CRUD operations on employee language proficiency data within the OrangeHRM system, including methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee language records with detailed validation and documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee language record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all language records associated with a specific employee.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a new language record for an employee after validation and uniqueness check.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee language record identified by employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified employee language records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing employee language records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting employee language records.
